capabilities: pull Steam overlay notes into vault Markdown files per game
push Obsidian edits back into Steam's local notes files
convert Steam BBCode formatting to Markdown and back
import attached note images and embed them in notes
back up Steam files before push and restore them
extras: Push writes into Steam's local files and the README carries strong warnings: close games and the Steam Notes editor before pushing, and avoid editing notes in Steam for a few minutes afterwards or Steam's in-memory copy can overwrite the push. Desktop-only; Steam's notes format is unofficial and a client update could break it. New Obsidian-only notes cannot yet be created on the Steam side.
motivation: The author lists community complaints about Steam Notes (lost notes, no export, overlay-only access) and built the plugin to address them.
problem: Steam's in-game notes can't be exported, backed up, searched, or edited outside the overlay, and users report edits and even whole notes disappearing.

relations.evidence: syncs your Steam Overlay game notes (Shift+Tab → Notes while playing) with your vault
relations.plugin: Steam (Steam Overlay Game Notes / Steam Cloud)

requires.name: Steam account (game-name lookup via Steam store API)

summary: Pulls Steam Overlay game notes into the vault as Markdown organized per game, and pushes Obsidian edits back into Steam's local notes files.
